## Attendance

The programme board met in December 2019. Attendance was recorded as follows: J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, A. Okonkwo, K. Lindqvist. J. Whitfield chaired the meeting.

## Performance

The board reviewed programme performance for December 2019. A total of 1777 captures was recorded during the month. The board also reviewed the outstanding position, including a backlog of 168 and 2 letters.

The figures were noted for monitoring through the programme’s routine performance arrangements. No further information was presented for additional consideration, and the board agreed that the position should continue to be kept under review.

## Items

No new incidents or changes were reported. The board considered the information provided and noted that the current position remained subject to ongoing monitoring. Matters not requiring a separate decision were recorded for continuity at the next meeting.

## Actions

Actions carried forward to the next meeting. The performance position, including captures, backlog and letters, is to remain under review. Any further updates arising before the next meeting should be incorporated into the routine programme reporting.
